problem_observed: Task Pipe summary cards and controls overflowed the desktop viewport.
Service Readiness content was squeezed into narrow columns and text wrapped vertically.
Performance budget failed because generated workspace snapshot was bundled as a fallback JavaScript chunk.
accepted_decisions: Make desktop-grid wide panels span the full runtime workbench width.
Use responsive grid sizing for task pipe, session launcher, runtime data, service readiness, and source editor controls.
Remove generated snapshot dynamic fallback and rely on public workspace-snapshot.json fetch for product/static builds.
rejected_options: Leave overflow hidden without fixing layout.
Raise the performance budget to allow the generated snapshot chunk.
Install or clone VS Code instead of using existing Monaco dependencies.
validation_gate: All checks, performance budget, customer bundle audit, and Browser smoke must pass before close-out.
